src: Defend HQ from wave of enemies invasion. The enemies Toys Nation are invading our HQ, it's your duty with your Squad to protect the HQ at all cost. Retreat to HQ after you completed defending all enemies wave or you could keep continue defending HQ to gather more Plastic from fallen enemies if necessary.
zh: 抵御一波波敌人，保卫总部。敌方玩具阵营正在进攻我们的总部，你有责任和小队一起不惜一切代价守住总部。击退所有敌军波次后即可撤回总部；如有需要，也可以继续坚守，从倒下的敌人身上收集更多塑料。

src: Bring your High Level Squad and Loadouts to protect HQ at all cost.
zh: 带上你的高等级小队和装备，不惜一切代价保卫总部。

src: Arthur Cutlass and Officer John are invading our HQ!

src: Beware of dangerous and highly explosive Firework Nuke that might caught you off guard!!
zh: 小心危险且威力巨大的烟花核弹，它可能会让你措手不及！！

src: Good morning Sarge! Welcome to the Army Man Boot Camp on your first day!
zh: 早上好，中士！欢迎来到塑料兵新兵训练营，这是你的第一天！

src: The Army Boot Camp will teach you the very basic of Combat, Skill, and Strategy.
zh: 新兵训练营将教你战斗、技能和战略的基础知识。

src: You are completely surrounded dead center and there is no way out.
zh: 你被团团包围在正中央，已经无路可退。

src: The War is started between all Toys Nations. Destroy all enemies HQ to Win the War. Friendly Toys will respawn back after death, but your Squad won't.
zh: 所有玩具阵营之间的战争已经打响。摧毁所有敌方总部即可赢得战争。友军玩具阵亡后会重生，但你的小队不会。

src: The War is started between all Toys Nations. Destroy all enemies HQ or Capture Territories to Win the War. Friendly Toys will respawn back after death, but your Squad won't. Capture more Plastic Generator Territories to get more Plastics for your advantages against enemies.
zh: 所有玩具阵营之间的战争已经打响。摧毁所有敌方总部或占领领地即可赢得战争。友军玩具阵亡后会重生，但你的小队不会。占领更多塑料发生器领地，获取更多塑料，取得对敌优势。

src: Fight against your friends in Split Screen Mode or Play Online with STEAM® REMOTE PLAY TOGETHER! Require two player or more to start a PvP match. Any progress (XP, Medal, Squad Death) will not affect your Save Data, so give everything you got and battle your friends to death!
zh: 在分屏模式下与好友对战，或通过 STEAM® 远程同乐在线游玩！PvP 对局需要两名或以上玩家才能开始。任何进度（经验、勋章、小队阵亡）都不会影响你的存档，所以尽情拼尽全力，和好友决一死战吧！

src: Toy-Box is a FreePlay Sandbox Mode, any progress (XP, Medal, Squad Death) will not affect your Save Data (Including Custom Toy Box Mode). There is no limit in Toy Box so you could create anything you want with your heart and content. Share your level creation through Workshop, Discord, and share your level creations to your friends (Open My Toy-Box Folder and find your .toybox file).
zh: 玩具箱是自由游玩的沙盒模式，任何进度（经验、勋章、小队阵亡）都不会影响你的存档（包括自定义玩具箱模式）。玩具箱没有任何限制，你可以随心所欲地创造任何东西。通过创意工坊、Discord 分享你的关卡作品，也可以分享给好友（打开“我的玩具箱文件夹”，找到你的 .toybox 文件）。
